lines.en: label ioarchery35:
scene iotearoom1
: Ahh...Finally, some peace and quiet.
lines.zh: : 啊……总算清静了。

lines.en: : You know, you’d think kyudo of all things would be the quietest of all the clubs...but between Uta and Kirin, I just don’t know sometimes.
lines.zh: : 你说，弓道怎么着也该是全校最安静的社团吧……可夹在 Uta 和 Kirin 中间，有时候我真说不准。

lines.en: : That’s weird.  Uta’s usually so focused when it comes to archery.
lines.zh: : 真奇怪。Uta 射箭的时候一向很专注的。

lines.en: : Yeah, but Kirin does this thing where she pollutes any environment she’s thrown into and, sometimes, that leads to Uta getting pulled back to her normal Uta-ish ways.
lines.zh: : 是啊，但 Kirin 有这本事——她被扔进什么环境，就能把什么环境污染掉；有时候这会把 Uta 拽回她那副正常的「Uta 样」。

lines.en: : I never have to worry about that with you, though. Because even when you’re talkative, which doesn’t happen much, you’re still kind of quiet.
lines.zh: : 不过跟你在一起我从来不用担心这个。因为就算你话多——虽然很少见——你也还是挺安静的。

lines.en: : And you’re kind of hugging my leg so hard that it’s cutting off my circulation.
lines.zh: : 还有，你抱着我的腿抱得有点太紧，我的血都不流通了。

lines.en: : That’s fine. I can probably make a sweet prosthetic after a few tries. Believe in me, Sensei. I’ll help you learn to walk again.
lines.zh: : 没关系。试个几次我大概就能做出一条超赞的假肢。相信我，Sensei。我会帮你重新学会走路的。

lines.en: I find myself in...what I believe is the tea ceremony room, but I might be incorrect about that as all I can remember from the last time I was in here is how red Uta’s face was.
lines.zh: 我发现自己身处……我猜是茶室，但我可能记错了——因为上次我在这里时，唯一记得的就是 Uta 的脸有多红。

lines.en: But this time, I’ve taken up temporary residence with her best friend instead and Uta is none the wiser.
lines.zh: 但这一次，我暂时在这里和她最好的朋友同居，而 Uta 一无所知。

lines.en: All the while, I cautiously and quietly bang invisible nails into an invisible wall I put up around myself to remind me not to do what isn’t welcome with today’s guest.
lines.zh: 其间，我小心翼翼、悄无声息地往自己周围那堵看不见的墙上钉着看不见的钉子，提醒自己：对今天这位客人，别做不受欢迎的事。

lines.en: Not to make any sort of advances or allude to any sort of impurity- because that wall is visible to one person and that person is, you guessed it...me.
lines.zh: 不要有任何进犯，也不要影射任何不洁——因为这堵墙只有一个人看得见，而那个人，你猜对了……就是我自己。

lines.en: I can do this.
lines.zh: 我做得到。

lines.en: I did it with Molly and I can do it with Io.
lines.zh: 我对 Molly 做到了，那我对 Io 也能做到。

lines.en: I can accept that not everyone has an inherent desire to sleep with me and I can grow in ways dissimilar to the way I grow the most.
lines.zh: 我能接受「不是每个人都天生想跟我上床」，我也能以不同于自己最擅长的方式去成长。

lines.en: I can be a better person.
lines.zh: 我能成为一个更好的人。

lines.en: I can learn to protect things.
lines.zh: 我能学会去保护一些东西。

lines.en: And if I can be better, that means Io can too.
lines.zh: 而如果我能变好，那就意味着 Io 也能。

lines.en: The two of us are adaptable. We’re different in a million other ways, but our resilience and the fact that our skin can camouflage to match its surroundings is what makes the two of us work as well as we do.
lines.zh: 我们两个适应性都很强。我们在其他无数方面都不一样，但正是我们的韧性、以及我们的皮肤能伪装成周围环境的颜色这一点，让我们两个相处得这么好。

lines.en: Or as well as I think we do.
lines.zh: 或者说，有我以为的那么好。

lines.en: Or as well as she thinks we do, but I don’t understand because the way I think isn’t the way she thinks and the things I do aren’t the things she’d do when the two of us are thinking.
lines.zh: 或者，有她以为的那么好——但我不明白，因为我思考的方式不是她思考的方式，而当我们两个都在思考时，我做的事也不是她会做的事。

lines.en: When the two of us are thinking is when we grow the closest.
lines.zh: 当我们两个都在思考的时候，才是我们靠得最近的时候。

lines.en: But it’s also the scariest time of all — because every single word strips a plank from the bridge between us.
lines.zh: 但那也是最可怕的时候——因为每说出一个字，都会从我们之间的桥上拆走一块木板。

lines.en: And one day, when we’re older and exhausted, our skin will lose its color.
lines.zh: 而有一天，等我们老了、精疲力竭了，我们的皮肤会失去颜色。

lines.en: One of us will lose the will to adapt.
lines.zh: 我们其中一个会失去适应的意愿。

lines.en: And sometimes, it feels like it’s a race to get to that point and see who will break first.
lines.zh: 有时候，这感觉像是一场赛跑——看谁先跑到那一步，看谁先崩溃。

lines.en: But right now, the two of us are thinking.
lines.zh: 但现在，我们两个都在思考。

lines.en: And only one of us has thoughts that can be spoken out loud.
lines.zh: 而我们之中，只有一个人的想法能说出口。

lines.en: : Hey...Sensei?
lines.zh: : 嘿……Sensei？

lines.en: : Yeah?
: I really like you.
lines.zh: : 我真的很喜欢你。

lines.en: : I know. You’ve already confessed on multiple occasions.
lines.zh: : 我知道。你已经表白过好几次了。

lines.en: : I’m just gonna keep doing it, you know.
lines.zh: : 我还会继续说下去的，你知道吧。

lines.en: : I feel safe when I’m with you. Which makes me want to confess my feelings because it’s the one time I know I’m not going to be judged for them.
lines.zh: : 跟你在一起我很有安全感。这让我想把心意说出来，因为只有在这种时候，我确定自己不会因此被评判。

lines.en: : I judge you all the time. The same way you judge me.
lines.zh: : 我一直在评判你啊。就像你也一直在评判我一样。

lines.en: : Sure, but it seems to me like we keep ruling in one another’s favor if we can still sit here like this.
lines.zh: : 话是这么说，可要是我们还能像这样坐在一起，我觉得我们一直在给对方做出有利的判决。

lines.en: : Then it seems to me like your judgement is just as shot as everything else about you.
lines.zh: : 那在我看来，你的判断力跟你身上其他一切一样，都烂透了。

lines.en: scene iotearoom2
: Yeah. I kinda suck, don’t I?
lines.zh: : 是啊。我挺烂的，对吧？

lines.en: : And you have stupid hair.
lines.zh: : 而且你的头发很蠢。

lines.en: : And I’m really mean to all the girls you like.
lines.zh: : 而且我对你喜欢的每个女生都很刻薄。

lines.en: : Remind me, why do you keep me around again? What are you getting out of this? Because we already know it’s not the thing you want.
lines.zh: : 提醒我一下，你到底为什么还留我在身边？你能从中得到什么？反正我们知道，你要的那个东西是得不到的。

lines.en: : What I’m getting is the opportunity to spend time with a cute girl that’s hopelessly devoted to me.
lines.zh: : 我得到的是——能和一个无可救药地迷恋着我的可爱女孩共度时光的机会。

lines.en: : But you’ve got tons of those. And most of them don’t have stupid hair or stupid mental health issues.
lines.zh: : 可那样的女孩你有一大堆啊。而且她们大多数既没有蠢头发，也没有蠢兮兮的心理健康问题。

lines.en: : Then I guess I’m just a masochist and like making things difficult for myself.
lines.zh: : 那我大概就是个受虐狂，喜欢把事情弄得很麻烦吧。

lines.en: scene iotearoom1
: Ahh, yes. The “When life gives you lemons, squeeze them into your eyes” method. I know it quite well.
lines.zh: : 啊，对。「当生活给你柠檬，就把柠檬汁挤进眼睛里」那套方法。我熟得很。

lines.en: : Has your reason for wanting to be with me expanded beyond just “I was in the right place at the right time” yet?
lines.zh: : 你想跟我在一起的理由，已经不只是「我恰好在对的时间出现在对的地点」了吗？

lines.en: : Of course. Do you really think I could just endlessly hug anyone? It should be obvious how precious you are to me by now.
lines.zh: : 当然。你真以为我能没完没了地抱任何人吗？到现在你都该看出来了，你对我有多珍贵。

lines.en: : Just don’t ask me to describe why or how since I don’t have a reasonable explanation for it and will likely just make it sound like I don’t really care when, in all actuality, I do.
lines.zh: : 只是别让我解释为什么、怎么个珍贵法——我给不出合理的解释，而且我很可能会说得好像我根本不在乎，可实际上我在乎得要命。

lines.en: : I care a lot.
lines.zh: : 我非常在乎。

lines.en: : I even had a dream about you last night. You wanna hear it?
lines.zh: : 我昨晚还梦到你了。想听吗？

lines.en: : Was I better or worse in the dream than I am in real life?
lines.zh: : 梦里的我比现实中好还是差？

lines.en: : You were a cat.
lines.zh: : 你是一只猫。

lines.en: : I...can’t figure out which one of the categories I listed that falls into.
lines.zh: : 我……搞不清这算我列的哪一类。

lines.en: : Do you ever dream about me?
lines.zh: : 你梦到过我吗？

lines.en: : Do you ever dream about anything?
lines.zh: : 你梦到过什么吗？

lines.en: : It’s not uncommon for some people to just never dream, you know. And I won’t be offended if REM-Sensei isn’t wasting any thoughts on Io when Io isn’t even worth any thoughts in real life.
lines.zh: : 有些人就是从来不做梦，这并不罕见，你知道的。再说了，反正现实里的 Io 连让人想一下都不值，REM 期的 Sensei 要是没把心思浪费在 Io 身上，我也不会生气。

lines.en: : It’s not like I don’t dream or anything...I just don’t do it very often and, when I do, what I see normally doesn’t make much sense.
lines.zh: : 我又不是不做梦……只是不常做，而且就算做了，看到的通常也没什么逻辑。

lines.en: : But the question I posed was if you ever see me. Even if it’s for something weird, like...helping you build a go-kart or something.
lines.zh: : 可我问的是你有没有梦见过我。哪怕是些奇怪的场景，比如……帮你造辆卡丁车什么的。

lines.en: : I...can’t really remember. But I’ll try and keep track for your sake if it makes you happy.
lines.zh: : 我……实在记不起来了。不过如果这能让你开心，我会试着记一下的。

lines.en: scene iotearoom3
: You’re being really nice today. Do you feel weird around me now?
lines.zh: : 你今天特别温柔。你现在跟我待在一起觉得别扭吗？

lines.en: : Io, come on.
lines.zh: : Io，别闹了。

lines.en: : What? It’s a genuine question. I’m difficult enough as-is. The last thing I need is you having another reason to show up at somebody else’s door instead of mine.
lines.zh: : 什么嘛？我是认真的。我本来就够难搞的了。我最不需要的，就是再多一个理由让你去敲别人的门、而不是我的。

lines.en: : Well, if I said yes, what would you even do about it?
lines.zh: : 那要是我说是呢，你又能怎么办？

lines.en: : Internally? Hate myself. Externally? Maybe a big hug or something.
lines.zh: : 内心？恨死自己。外在？大概会抱你一下之类的。

lines.en: : You still haven’t cashed in on that kiss I said you could have. That might pull you back to my side, right?
lines.zh: : 我说过可以给你那个吻，你到现在都没来兑现。那也许能把你拉回我这边，对吧？

lines.en: : I don’t think it’s a good idea for us to do that right now.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们现在做那件事不太好。

lines.en: scene iotearoom4
: Why not?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Trust me. It’s just better for both of us if we stick to...cuddling or whatever for now.
lines.zh: : 相信我。我们暂时就……抱一抱之类的，对彼此都更好。

lines.en: : Why do you always pause like that before you say cute words like “cuddle?”
lines.zh: : 你为什么每次说「抱一抱」这种可爱的话之前都要停顿一下？

lines.en: : Come to think of it, you never really say anything cute in the first place. It’s always straight-laced, semi-formal dialogue with you. Like you’re following the unofficial handbook on mid-thirties male speech.
lines.zh: : 话说回来，你本来就不怎么说话可爱。你说话总是一本正经、半正式的，像是照着《三十多岁男性说话方式非正式手册》来的。

lines.en: : Early-thirties. And I don’t know. That’s just kind of how I talk, I guess.
lines.zh: : 三十出头。而且我也不知道。大概我就这么说话吧。

lines.en: : There wasn’t like, somebody who taught you to speak that way? To never say anything fun?
lines.zh: : 就没有什么人教过你这么说话吗？教得你从来不说有趣的话？

lines.en: : I say fun stuff all the time. Or...at least I think it’s fun. But I’ve been calling this my hot boy summer for months and no one has laughed yet, so maybe my sense of humor just sucks.
lines.zh: : 我经常说有趣的话啊。或者……至少我觉得有趣。但我把这几个月叫成我的「猛男之夏」，到现在也没人笑过，所以也许我的幽默感就是很烂。

lines.en: : Say more fun things around me. Tell me a joke or something. Go.
lines.zh: : 那在我面前多说点有趣的话。讲个笑话什么的。来吧。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: I’m waiting.
lines.zh: : 我等着呢。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m aware. It’s been two seconds. It’s just kind of hard to think of any jokes on the spot like that.
lines.zh: : 知道啊，才过了两秒。临场想笑话本来就挺难的。

lines.en: scene iotearoom5
: I have one! You wanna hear it?
lines.zh: : 我有一个！想听吗？

lines.en: : Yes, but I will judge you harshly if it’s not funny.
lines.zh: : 想，但要是不好笑，我会狠狠地评判你。

lines.en: : Deal. What do corporate woodworkers do when they need to discuss their next project?
lines.zh: : 成交。企业里的木工们要讨论下一个项目时会做什么？

lines.en: : They have a board meeting!
lines.zh: : 开董事会啊！

lines.en: : Get it? Like...board. Like...wood. A wooden board.
lines.zh: : 懂了吗？就是……board（板／董事会）。就是……木头。一块木板。

lines.en: : I get it. That silence was just me judging you harshly.
lines.zh: : 我懂了。刚才那段沉默就是我在狠狠地评判你。

lines.en: scene iotearoom6
: Hey, it could’ve been worse. It could’ve been, like...Tsuneyo’s stand-up set bad.
lines.zh: : 嘿，本来可能更糟的。比如……糟成 Tsuneyo 那场单口秀那样。

lines.en: : I am...very thankful it was not.
lines.zh: : 我……非常庆幸不是。

lines.en: : What was that even about anyway? Like, raunchy humor is one thing...but to just blatantly start spreading ridiculous lies about people? That’s like...kind of fucked up, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 那到底是些什么玩意儿啊？下流幽默是一回事……可明目张胆地开始散布关于别人的荒唐谣言？那……有点变态了吧？

lines.en: : Thank god nobody believed her. Cause all that stuff about the chuuni girl was actually nauseating. And another thing-
lines.zh: : 谢天谢地没人信她。她讲的那些关于那个中二女孩的事真的让人作呕。还有一件事——

lines.en: : Hey, on the topic of the Dorm Wars, how are you feeling going into this year’s competition? Are you actually going to try?
lines.zh: : 嘿，说到宿舍大战，你对今年的比赛感觉怎么样？你真的打算好好干一场吗？

lines.en: scene iotearoom7
: I’m glad you asked! Because I am going to try this year!
lines.zh: : 你问得正好！因为我今年打算认真干一场！

lines.en: : Crazy things happen when you let Io do a thing Io actually wants to do. Which, to be fair, isn’t many things. But building a raft? That sounds super fun. I’ve never tried anything like that before.
lines.zh: : 让 Io 去做她真正想做的事，是会出大事的。说实话这种事不多。但造木筏？听起来超好玩。我从来没试过那种东西。

lines.en: : Plus, I get to compete against Miku! And I don’t despise her!
lines.zh: : 而且我还能跟 Miku 同场竞技！而且我不讨厌她！

lines.en: : Yeah...you two seem to be seeing each other pretty often nowadays, huh?
lines.zh: : 是啊……你们俩最近好像经常见面啊？

lines.en: scene iotearoom8
: That’s right! I am her pharmacist after all.
lines.zh: : 没错！我可是她的药剂师。

lines.en: : Except...you’re not. You’re a random girl with a surplus of pills who doesn’t mind handing them out to other people.
lines.zh: : 只是……你不是。你就是个药多到吃不完、又不介意分给别人的普通女孩。

lines.en: : Isn’t that what pharmacists do?
lines.zh: : 药剂师不就是干这个的吗？

lines.en: : Io, I’m trying to lecture you.
lines.zh: : Io，我在试图教训你。

lines.en: scene iotearoom9
: Why?! Today was going so well! Can’t we save all the serious conversation until next time or something?
lines.zh: : 为什么？！今天明明一直都很好！我们就不能把严肃的话题留到下次之类的吗？

lines.en: scene black
I shift my lower body away from Io and inadvertently force her off of me.
lines.zh: 我把下半身从 Io 身边挪开，无意间把她从我身上挤了下去。

lines.en: There’s a moment of hesitance as she tries to figure out whether or not she should attempt to steal my leg again- and there’s a second moment when she reaches toward me with lightly-trembling hands.
lines.zh: 她迟疑了一瞬，似乎在判断要不要再把我的腿抢回去——接着是第二个瞬间，她伸出微微发抖的手朝我够过来。

lines.en: My lack of morals prevents me from swatting her away as I don’t think it’s right to punish anyone for anything when I’m sure I’ve done much worse.
lines.zh: 我那点缺失的道德观让我没法把她挥开——因为我确信自己干过比这糟得多的事，也就没资格为了任何事去惩罚任何人。

lines.en: But I do stare into her eyes in a way I’ve only done a few times before.
lines.zh: 但我确实盯着她的眼睛看，那种注视我之前只做过寥寥几次。

lines.en: I haven’t had to look this way at any other girl — but Io feels less like a girl and more like a feral cat I need  to housebreak at times.
lines.zh: 我还从没用这种眼神看过别的女生——只是 Io 有时候不太像个女孩，更像一只需要我驯服的野猫。

lines.en: She does so many things that just go against all common sense, but...
lines.zh: 她做了太多违背常理的事，可……

lines.en: I guess I do too.
lines.zh: 我大概也一样。

lines.en: And I guess that might be why she sees me the same way in her sleep.
lines.zh: 而我想，这也许就是她在梦里也用同样的方式看待我的原因。

lines.en: scene iotearoom10
: Am I in trouble?
lines.zh: : 我是不是惹麻烦了？

lines.en: : Do I have the authority to ground you?
lines.zh: : 我有权力禁你的足吗？

lines.en: : Not technically. But I like you enough to humor you by acting grounded. Plus, it’s not like I ever go anywhere in the first place. If anything, being grounded sounds kind of like a vacation.
lines.zh: : 严格来说没有。但我足够喜欢你，愿意配合你演一出被禁足的戏。再说了，反正我本来哪儿也不去。要说的话，被禁足听起来还挺像度假的。

lines.en: : Io, why are you medicating Miku when-
lines.zh: : Io，你为什么要给 Miku 用药——

lines.en: scene iotearoom11
: Because no one else is!
lines.zh: : 因为没有别人在管她！

lines.en: scene iotearoom12
: I’m doing it because no one else is...
lines.zh: : 我做这件事，是因为没有别人在做……

lines.en: : Miku’s got severe PTSD that was entirely untreated before I started sharing my medication with her.
lines.zh: : Miku 有严重的创伤后应激障碍，在我开始跟她分药之前，完全没得到过任何治疗。

lines.en: : Do you have any idea what it’s like having to just fucking...raw dog that? It’s terrible. And it was holding her back from...living a normal life.
lines.zh: : 你知道就这么他妈的……硬扛过去是什么感觉吗？糟透了。而那一直在拖着她，让她没法……过正常人的生活。

lines.en: : And living a normal life when your trauma is that fucking earth-shattering?...Well, that's...that's one of the hardest things anyone could ever even attempt to do.
lines.zh: : 而当你的创伤他妈的那么天崩地裂时，想过上正常人的生活？……嗯，那……那是任何人能尝试的最难的事之一。

lines.en: : But that doesn’t make it okay to-
lines.zh: : 可这也不能让你就这么——

lines.en: scene iotearoom13
: Well, what would you do instead?! Have her just deal with it on her own?!
lines.zh: : 那你打算怎么办？！让她自己一个人扛着？！

lines.en: : You’ve seen her panic attacks, right?! She can barely breathe when they happen! And it’s not like you can just prevent her triggers from ever showing up, right?! So then what?! What would you do?!
lines.zh: : 你见过她惊恐发作对吧？！发作的时候她几乎喘不上气！而且你又不可能让那些触发因素永远不出现，对吧？！那到底怎么办？！你会怎么做？！

lines.en: : I’d...leave it to the professionals.
lines.zh: : 我会……交给专业人士。

lines.en: : Oh, so they could throw a bunch of shit at her and just see which one sticks?! It takes forever to find the right medication for some people! Not to mention dosage and the cost and-
lines.zh: : 哦，好让他们把一堆狗屁药往她身上砸，看哪个管用是吧？！有些人要找到合适的药得花上好几年！更别提剂量、费用，还有——

lines.en: : And you’re not even her guardian! In fact, she doesn’t even have a guardian if I’m understanding her situation correctly!
lines.zh: : 而且你甚至不是她的监护人！事实上，如果我没理解错她的处境，她连个监护人都没有！

lines.en: : There’s nothing anyone can do but me and I can’t just sit back and watch her suffer when I know I can help!
lines.zh: : 除了我没人能做什么，而我明明知道自己帮得上忙，就不能坐视她受苦！

lines.en: : I know you’re just trying to help. But what you’re doing is dangerous and you know that.
lines.zh: : 我知道你只是想帮忙。但你在做的事很危险，你自己也清楚。

lines.en: scene iotearoom14
: You know what’s even more dangerous? Not treating her.
lines.zh: : 你知道什么更危险吗？不给她治疗。

lines.en: : Miku is doing a million times better now. And that’s not just me saying it to save face. She’ll tell you herself.
lines.zh: : Miku 现在好了一百万倍。这可不是我为了面子说的。她自己也会这么告诉你。

lines.en: : Fuck, she probably doesn’t even need to tell you. Just take one look at her and you’ll realize how much easier her life has gotten lately.
lines.zh: : 操，她大概都不用跟你说。你只要看她一眼，就会明白她最近的日子轻松了多少。

lines.en: : I know Miku way better than you do, Io.
lines.zh: : 我比你要了解 Miku 得多，Io。

lines.en: scene iotearoom15
: Then you should know how much help she needs.
lines.zh: : 那你就该知道她需要多少帮助。

lines.en: : Too many people just shrug mental health issues off because it makes them uncomfortable and it’s shit like that that winds up killing people.
lines.zh: : 太多人因为心理健康问题让自己不舒服，就耸耸肩把它撇开；正是这种狗屁东西最后会害死人。

lines.en: : I’m not going to abandon her when I’m making a real difference in her life. You know that’s what I want to do with mine. I’ve told you that.
lines.zh: : 我给她的生活带来了实实在在的改变，我不会在这时候抛下她。你知道我这辈子想做的就是这件事。我跟你说过的。

lines.en: : When you told me that, you were talking about toys...not pills.
lines.zh: : 你说那句话的时候，说的是玩具……不是药。

lines.en: scene iotearoom16
: Right, yeah. Let’s just pull her off the working medication and throw a fucking toy at her the next time she has a panic attack. That’ll work.
lines.zh: : 对，是啊。那就把她从有效的药上撤下来，下次她惊恐发作时扔个他妈的玩具给她。肯定管用。

lines.en: : Io, that’s not what I’m suggesting and you know that.
lines.zh: : Io，我不是这个意思，你心里清楚。

lines.en: : Of course I know that. But I’m mad at you right now and I’m probably going to be a little more sarcastic than normal for a few minutes. If that’s going to be a problem, then just leave.
lines.zh: : 我当然清楚。但我现在正在气头上，接下来几分钟我大概会比平时更阴阳怪气一点。要是这成问题，那你走就是了。

lines.en: : You really care about Miku, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你是真的在乎 Miku，对吧？

lines.en: : Not really.
lines.zh: : 也不是。

lines.en: : So you’re doing all of this for...what? The principle of it?
lines.zh: : 那你做这一切是为了……什么？为了原则？

lines.en: : I’m doing it for myself. But not in a “Playing pharmacist makes me feel like I have a purpose” sort of way.
lines.zh: : 我是为了我自己。但不是那种「扮演药剂师让我觉得自己有存在意义」的层面。

lines.en: : I’m doing it because if I had to look my issues in the eye, I know how I’d feel. And I wouldn’t wish that on my worst fucking enemy.
lines.zh: : 我做这件事，是因为如果让我直视自己的问题，我知道那是什么感觉。而那种感觉，我连我最他妈恨的敌人都不愿让他承受。

lines.en: : So...what then?
lines.zh: : 那么……接下来呢？

lines.en: : I don’t know. Sounds like you’re gonna tell on me or something. And then Miku will just be fucked until someone else comes along and decides she’s worth helping.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。听起来你是要去告发我什么的。然后 Miku 就这么完蛋了，直到有下一个出现、认定她值得被帮为止。

lines.en: : I’m not the type to “tell” on anyone, Io.
lines.zh: : 我不是那种会去「告发」别人的人，Io。

lines.en: : You just have to realize how this looks from the outside.
lines.zh: : 你只是得明白，这事从外面看是什么样子。

lines.en: : It just seems pretty fucked up that I got confronted for helping her before anyone confronted her about getting help.
lines.zh: : 我因为帮她而被找上门，却从没有人先去找她谈「去接受帮助」这件事——这他妈的也太离谱了。

lines.en: : That’s the kind of shit people like me have to go through, Sensei. No one ever helps themselves. It always starts with somebody talking us into doing something and then us figuring shit out later.
lines.zh: : 这就是我们这种人不得不经历的狗屁事，Sensei。没有人会自己帮自己。事情总是从某个人把我们劝动开始，然后我们再去一点点搞清楚。

lines.en: : God forbid I ever try and be that for another person. God forbid I ever do anything that isn’t in my best interest.
lines.zh: : 但愿我千万别试图成为别人的那个人。但愿我千万别做任何不符合自身利益的事。

lines.en: : But didn’t you say just a second ago that you were doing this for yourself?
lines.zh: : 可你刚才不是还说，你做这件事是为了你自己吗？

lines.en: : Shut up.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴。

lines.en: : You really do care about her after all, huh?
lines.zh: : 说到底，你是真的很在乎她啊？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : Do you want to lay on my lap again?
lines.zh: : 要不要再躺到我腿上？

lines.en: scene iotearoom17
: Huh? Aren’t we mad at each other?
lines.zh: : 咦？我们不是在生气吗？

lines.en: : I was a little mad in the beginning. But not anymore after hearing your rationale behind all this.
lines.zh: : 一开始我是有点生气。但听你说完这背后的理由，就不气了。

lines.en: : So...wait. Where does that put us in regard to the medication situation? Can I keep sharing my stuff with Miku?
lines.zh: : 那……等等。那在用药这件事上，我们算怎么回事？我还能继续跟 Miku 分我的药吗？

lines.en: : I...won’t stop you. But I want you to try and talk her into getting help from an actual professional rather than someone who just...has way too much experience.
lines.zh: : 我……不会阻止你。但我希望你试着劝她去找真正的专业人士求助，而不是找一个只是……经验过于丰富的人。

lines.en: : I’m not good at talking. You know this. If I talk to Miku, she’ll probably give up on taking medication altogether and just jump off a bridge.
lines.zh: : 我不擅长说话。你知道的。我要是去跟 Miku 说，她大概会干脆彻底停药，然后从桥上跳下去。

lines.en: : Then give her a phone number or...something. I don’t know. I have no idea how any of this works.
lines.zh: : 那就给她一个电话号码或者……什么的东西。我不知道。我完全不懂这些事该怎么处理。

lines.en: scene iotearoom18
: Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : What now? I thought that was a pretty good ending to all of this.
lines.zh: : 又怎么了？我以为这已经是个挺不错的收尾了。

lines.en: : It was, just...
lines.zh: : 是啊，只是……

lines.en: : Have you...
lines.zh: : 你有没有……

lines.en: : Have you really never tried taking anything to help with your...problems?
lines.zh: : 你真的从来没试过吃点什么来缓解你的……问题吗？

lines.en: : You don’t have to go it alone, you know.
lines.zh: : 你不用一个人扛着，你知道的。

lines.en: : Are you going to start treating me now too?
lines.zh: : 你现在也要开始给我治了？

lines.en: : Don’t turn this into a joke. I think you could really stand to benefit from...something.
lines.zh: : 别把它变成玩笑。我觉得你真的能从……某种东西里获益。

lines.en: : I’m just...not sure what.
lines.zh: : 我只是……不确定是什么。

lines.en: : I’ll be fine. I’ve made it to 31 without anything like that and I’ll make it to 32 if the world ever goes back to-
lines.zh: : 我没事的。没有那些东西我也活到了 31 岁，只要世界还能回到——我就能活到 32 岁。

lines.en: : I just really think you should reconsider. I want you to be happy and...it’s not like anything I can do will ever get you to that point.
lines.zh: : 我只是真的觉得你应该重新考虑一下。我想让你幸福，而且……反正我能做的任何事，都不可能把你带到那个地方。

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei？

lines.en: scene black
: Just lay back down, Io.
lines.zh: : 躺回去就好，Io。
